standard.title: Quand as Temporal Conjunction
standard.explanation: The word 'quand' (when) as a conjunction connects two clauses, both in present tense for habitual actions. Example: 'Quand je fais du sport, je me sens bien.' (When I do sport, I feel good.) Do not confuse 'quand' as a conjunction (when, linking clauses) with 'quand' as a question word ('Quand est-ce que tu viens?' = When are you coming?). As a conjunction, 'quand' introduces a time clause showing when an action happens, and the main clause expresses the result or consequence. Both verbs are in the present tense when describing what regularly happens.

advanced.title: Quand as Temporal Conjunction — When + Present & Common Patterns
advanced.explanation: The conjunction 'quand' (when) links two clauses to show the timing or relationship between actions. In present tense: 'Quand je fais du sport, je me sens bien' (When I do sport, I feel good) expresses habitual or general truths. Both clauses use present tense. 'Quand' differs from the question word 'quand' (Quand est-ce que tu arrives?). As a temporal conjunction, 'quand' can also appear with past or future tenses: 'Quand j'ai joué au tennis, j'étais heureux' (When I played tennis, I was happy) or 'Quand j'aurai terminé mon entraînement, je te rappellerai' (When I finish my training, I will call you back). The verb tense after 'quand' depends on the time frame being discussed.

standard.scenario: Describe the sports you practise and how often you do them.
standard.modelAnswer: Je joue au foot deux fois par semaine. Je fais de la natation une fois par semaine. Je fais aussi du jogging le dimanche. J'aime le sport!
standard.modelAnswerExplanation: You mention the sports you play with their frequency. This is a natural way to talk about your sports activities and exercise routine.
standard.tip: Remember: 'jouer au/aux' for ball sports, 'faire de la/du' for other activities. Always include how often you do them: once a week, twice a week, etc.

advanced.scenario: Explain to a friend why you enjoy sports, how sports make you feel, and discuss your training routine and fitness goals.
advanced.modelAnswer: Quand je fais du sport, je me sens énergique et heureux. J'aime le sport parce qu'il me maintient en bonne santé. Habituellement, je m'entraîne trois fois par semaine. Mon objectif est de rester en forme et d'améliorer ma performance.
advanced.modelAnswerExplanation: You use 'quand + present' to explain what sports do for you emotionally and physically. You also mention your training frequency and fitness goals, showing commitment to your health.
advanced.tip: Use 'quand + présent' (When I do sport, I feel...) to describe the relationship between exercise and your feelings. Be specific about your goals and training schedule.
